page.layout: One page, blank except for a library stamp near the centre. The stamp is an oval seal with a shield and is not transcribed. Faint lines of show-through from the other side run through the middle and lower part of the page.
page.notes: The page carries no printed text that can be read. An oval library stamp (a shield with a motto and the words BIBLIOTHECA ACADEMIAE around the rim) sits in the centre and is left out as a stamp. Faint lines of mirrored text (show-through) fill the central column and the lower part of the page. Near the foot there may be a faint line of printing, but it cannot be read with any certainty, so nothing is transcribed.
